root.gloss: to wake up, awaken; to keep watch

examples.pie: kʷíd péh₂ure súHnew ne h₁gérs? h₂mélǵos moy wékʷsperoy pstnés péh₃s. nu túH ḱolHtós h₂ewsér h₁és. gʷoldʰós te sléh₂gʷt ne-kʷe me sléh₂gʷt. HréwdHmi-ge ph₂tḗr-kʷe toy HréwdHti. súHnew moy sríHǵesi ḱéyso.
examples.en: Little son, why did you not wake? In the evening you drank milk from my breast. Then at dawn you were cold. Hunger took you, and it did not take me. I weep indeed, and your father weeps. Lie, my son, in the cold.

examples.pie: pótey moy h₂éwsōs swépnoy gʷémt. h₂éwsōs diwés dʰugh₂tḗr? ḱubʰréh₂ h₁ést h₂éndʰos-kʷe moy déh₃t. nu kúdʰe h₂éndʰos h₁ésti? h₁gérm̥ h₂éndʰos-kʷe néḱt. mē HréwdHs. h₂éwsōs toy téḱnom dh₃yéh₁t. deywṓs te ḱluwih₁ént.
examples.en: Husband, Dawn came to me in sleep. Dawn, the daughter of Sky? She was beautiful, and she gave me a flower. Where is the flower now? I woke up, and the flower vanished. Do not weep. May Dawn give you a child! May the gods hear you!

examples.pie: h₁yód deywṓs h₂ḱh₃ént mḗms h₁édomes. médʰu píph₃ōmes kéh₂nmn̥h₂-kʷe séngʷʰōmes. ǵérh₂ontes swṓm ph₂trṓm spéleh₂ wérh₁onti. h₁yós luǵrós h₁ésti só méwdeti.

examples.en: Now I sit by the sea and look toward the dawn. There my sister waits for me. My wife is sad indeed at the hearth. I was a free man; I am a servant. Wind, carry my word across the sea.

examples.pie: nu moy bʰréh₂tēr dayh₂wérm̥ gʷʰént. kʷésmey h₁eǵóh₂ luǵréh₂ HréwdHoh₂? nu moy sweḱrúh₂ h₁mé h₃eh₃óde. ǵl̥h₂ṓws-ge moy th₂kéh₁yeti. téḱneh₂ moy méne bʰréh₂term̥ h₃eh₃óde. kŕ̥sna-ge me kʷsép nu h₁m̥dʰí.
examples.en: Now my brother has killed my husband's brother. For whom shall I, a wretched woman, weep? Now my mother-in-law hates me. My husband's sister is silent. My children hate my brother. Black night, take me now.

examples.pie: preḱnós méǵʰye h₁ésti. préḱsdʰi. h₂enterowékʷos wéwkōh₂. kʷóti wékʷesh₂ wóydth₂e? polh₁úh₂ wékʷesh₂ wóydh₂e.

examples.en: Helper, your answer is good. I give you thanks. Your joy is my joy. Ask a new question!

examples.pie: h₂enterowékʷos ne wéwkes. tód ne wéḱm̥. nu préḱsdʰi. kúdʰe moy ph₂trés h₁éḱwos h₁ésti? ne wóydh₂e. h₁éḱwom ne dedórḱh₂e.
examples.en: You did not speak the answer. I did not want that. Now ask! Where is my father's horse? I do not know. I have not seen the horse.
